ruleDefinitions.name: T1555.003 — Browser Credential Theft (Infostealer) (Fact #26)
ruleDefinitions.description: Browser Credential Theft (Infostealer). Trigger: Same masquerading process makes an outbound HTTPS connection immediately after touching browser credential stores
ruleDefinitions.detectionReason: A process running from AppData\Temp made an outbound HTTPS connection to {dest_ip}:{dest_port}
ruleDefinitions.suppressScope: JoinIfExists(EntityId('type: User && direction: Source'), EntityId('type: Device && direction: Source'))
